title: 夕佳书屋 Xijia Shuwu
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 3.2 m, ridge 5.56 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

by the hall kit: 3 bays, the middle widest, a porch front, steps on the front, 悬山 overhanging gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 藻园
evidence.excerpt_zh: 長春仙館由西南門迤西為藻園内為曠然堂五楹堂後為貯清書屋曠然堂東池上為夕佳書屋稍北為鏡瀾榭東南樓為凝眺為懷新館西北為湛碧軒西南為湛清華（圓明園冊）臣等謹按藻園曠然堂諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: Out by the south-west gate of 長春仙館: 藻園 with the five-bay 曠然堂, 貯清書屋, 夕佳書屋, 鏡瀾榭, the tower 凝眺, 懷新館, 湛碧軒 and 湛清華.

evidence.title: 夕佳书屋: 乾隆二十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十四年 (1759), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.183 item (1), under 夕佳书屋
evidence.excerpt_zh:
得胜虽各殊，称心斯为快。岂必在深谷，假山有清会。依依含夕阳，气佳屏一帯。屋名取陶诗，寓意夫何
害。既兴高贤慕，亦切叔世戒。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 夕佳书屋, 1759, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 夕佳书屋: 嘉庆二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二年 (1797), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.184 item (2), under 夕佳书屋
evidence.excerpt_zh: 返照在遥岭，书窗纳景光。山容开远绘，波影动斜阳。檐雀寻巢急，林鸦择树忙。夕佳更清迥，渐觉月辉扬。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 夕佳书屋, 1797, on reading and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 夕佳书屋: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.184 item (4), under 夕佳书屋
evidence.excerpt_zh: 斜晖印疎林，清光岩壑敛。纳景夕更佳，影叠池波潋。众绿透紫红，画法妙烘染。牛羊下遥坡，鸦背金万点。少焉月出东，琼辉上冉冉。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 夕佳书屋, 1798, on reading and the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 夕佳书屋有会
evidence.locator: v3 p.227, under 藻园; source ref 18-716
evidence.excerpt_zh: 御园惟假山，陶诗似不伦。然而吾名之，问何尊所闻。曾忆宋儒语，宵得
evidence.summary: Poem 夕佳书屋有会 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1794, filed by the editors under 藻园.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 夕佳书屋
evidence.summary: 夕佳书屋: 4 dated items, 1759-1798, of which 4 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: reading, the view. First dated 1759, last dated 1798.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
